scripts.build: npm -w @e2ee-kv/protocol run build && npm -w e2ee-kv-client run build && npm run -s assets:copy && npm -w e2ee-kv-server run build
scripts.assets:copy: rm -rf server/public && mkdir -p server/public && cp -r client/dist/. server/public/
scripts.test: npm -w @e2ee-kv/protocol test --if-present && npm -w e2ee-kv-server test --if-present && npm -w e2ee-kv-client test --if-present
